candidate.title: Closed-Loop Feedback Evaluation System
assumptions: Raw feedback arrives via push from product surfaces (in-app ratings, comments, support tickets); sources are push-only and the system does not solicit them.
The loop terminates at publishing versioned evaluation dataset updates; downstream model training or prompt changes are owned by other systems and are passive consumers.
Scoring combines automated rubric/AI-judge scoring with sampled human review; reviewers can override scores before dataset promotion.
Feedback may contain PII, so validation includes privacy screening before any scoring or storage in curated datasets.
Production maturity: each stage is owned, auditable, and supports reprocessing of rejected or contested records.

components.label: Feedback Intake Service
components.responsibility: Accepts pushed raw feedback from product surfaces, authenticates submissions, normalizes formats, assigns lineage IDs, persists to the raw store, and initiates the validation pipeline.

components.label: Raw Feedback Store
components.responsibility: Canonical, immutable store of raw feedback with source, timestamp, and lineage metadata; supports replay for reprocessing and audit.

components.label: Validation Service
components.responsibility: Validates schema completeness, deduplicates submissions, screens for PII and policy violations, and routes records as accepted, quarantined, or rejected with reasons.

components.label: Scoring Service
components.responsibility: Applies rubric and AI-judge scoring with confidence estimates to validated feedback, selects low-confidence or high-impact samples for human review, and writes score records.

components.label: Score & Evidence Store
components.responsibility: Stores scores, judge rationales, confidence values, and reviewer decisions per feedback record for traceability and dataset curation queries.

components.label: Human Review Workspace
components.responsibility: Reviewer UI for inspecting sampled or contested records, confirming or overriding automated scores, and approving records for dataset promotion.

components.label: Dataset Update Service
components.responsibility: Promotes reviewed, approved records into new evaluation dataset versions, manages reuse lifecycle and invalidation of superseded records, and publishes updates to the registry.

components.label: Evaluation Dataset Registry
components.responsibility: Versioned registry of curated evaluation datasets with provenance back to source feedback, scores, and review decisions; serves downstream consumers.

components.label: Product Feedback Sources
components.responsibility: External product surfaces (app UI, support channels) that push user ratings and free-text feedback to the intake service.

components.label: Pipeline Event Bus
components.responsibility: Async handoff between validation, scoring, review, and dataset update stages; buffers bursts and enables per-stage retry and failure isolation.

components.label: Audit & Reconciliation Log
components.responsibility: Append-only record of stage transitions, rejections, overrides, and dataset publications; supports reconciliation of intake counts against curated output.
